en.headline: Police investigate death of 69-year-old minibus driver dragged under vehicle in Clear Water Bay
en.dek: A 69-year-old green minibus driver died in hospital on Wednesday evening after the vehicle rolled forward while he was outside it at the junction of Clear Water Bay Road and Tai Au Mun Road.
body: Police are investigating a fatal incident in which a 69-year-old minibus driver was dragged beneath his vehicle on Clear Water Bay Road on Wednesday evening.

According to police, the driver of a Route 103M green minibus stopped near a bus stop opposite Clear Water Bay Garden at the junction with Tai Au Mun Road shortly after 6pm and got out. The vehicle then rolled forward, trapping him underneath. Firefighters extricated him and he was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he was certified dead at about 8pm.

No passengers were on board at the time. The East Kowloon Regional Traffic Unit is investigating the circumstances, including whether the handbrake was properly engaged. The deceased has not been named.

zh.headline: 清水灣道小巴司機被捲車底死亡 警方調查中
zh.dek: 一名69歲綠色小巴司機周三傍晚在清水灣道近大埉門路交界下車後，小巴溜前將他捲入車底，送院後不治，警方正調查事件。
body: 警方正調查一宗致命交通意外，一名69歲專線小巴司機周三傍晚在清水灣道被捲入自己的車輛車底後死亡。
警方表示，涉事司機駕駛103M綠色小巴，傍晚6時多在清水灣花園對開、清水灣道與大埉門路交界的巴士站附近停車並下車，其後小巴突然溜前，將他撞倒並困於車底。消防員到場救出，傷者送往將軍澳醫院，約晚上8時證實不治。
事發時車上並無乘客。東九龍總區交通部特別調查隊正調查事件經過，包括手摯是否妥善拉緊。死者姓名未有公布。
